name: Business Vault ETL/Modeling

content.title: ETL Foundations
content.description: Best practices for incremental loads and error handling

instructorBio: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry (Data Analysis). Skilled in SQL and Extract, Transform, Load (ETL). Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Computer and Communications Program from Alexandria University.
fullDescription:
The Business Vault layer extends the Raw Data Vault by incorporating business rules, derived attributes, and calculated metrics. It enables advanced analytics and reporting while maintaining the flexibility and auditability of the Data Vault methodology.

In this session, participants will:

- Explore ETL design patterns for loading hubs, links, and satellites.

- Learn how to apply business rules to enrich raw data into the Business Vault.

- Understand metadata-driven automation for ETL pipelines.

- Practice modeling techniques that support downstream marts and BI tools.
shortDescription: This session focuses on Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes and data modeling for the Business Vault layer within a Data Vault architecture. It provides both technical and conceptual guidance on how to design, implement, and optimize ETL workflows that feed the Business Vault, ensuring scalability, traceability, and business alignment.
whatYouWillLearn: Understand Business Vault → Clear grasp of its role in Data Vault architecture.
Design ETL Workflows → Ability to build scalable, auditable ETL pipelines.
Leverage Automation → Knowledge of metadata-driven automation for efficiency.

targetAudience: Data Heads, and Data Architecture team
fullDescription:
TOGAF (The Open Group Architecture Framework) is the globally recognized standard for Enterprise Architecture (EA). It provides a comprehensive methodology and structured approach for designing, planning, implementing, and governing enterprise-wide architectures.

At its core, TOGAF helps organizations align business strategy with data, applications, and technology, ensuring that IT investments directly support business goals. It offers a common language, set of principles, and best practices that guide architects in building scalable, interoperable, and future-proof systems.
shortDescription: TOGAF is the industry-standard Enterprise Architecture framework that provides a structured approach for designing, implementing, and governing enterprise architecture while aligning business, data, applications, and technology.
whatYouWillLearn: A framework and toolkit that empowers organizations to build architectures that are strategic, sustainable, and adaptable.
Strategic Alignment: Bridges the gap between IT and business strategy.
Scalability: Ensures architectures can evolve with organizational growth and technological change.
